Considering their geographical location, it is not surprising many of these Eastern European states oppose the French, German and Russian attempts to dissolve NATO. The UK should also seek to expand the scope and focus of NATO. The founding aim behind NATO was to protect Western Europe from the USSR. Her appraisal is a bit off in some respects. The purpose of NATO is to contain Russia. But at least originally it was also to keep Germany from ever becoming a military threat again. In light of this it is unsurprising that Germany is a NATO deadbeat in its expenditures and wants an EU army. The EU, at its core, is a kind of budding German Empire reliant on the German taxpayer to keep it afloat. This will especially be the case with Britain out.

She also has an almost laughably superficial understanding of the philosophy of Atlanticism itself from which NATO is based. Atlanticism represents the geopolitical unity of Western Civilization and the cultivation of a sense of community that comes with it. Cavalierly suggesting that non-Western states be brought into NATO and that much of Europe go its own way with an EU army is the very negation of the whole Atlanticist project. It is also a very dangerous idea to pit a US led bloc against a German led bloc.

It is still necessary, as the first NATO head Lord Ismay said, to keep Germany down. Britain leaving the EU undermines that as it cannot veto an EU army out of the EU.
